name: clockpane
description: World clocks and a time zone converter in the toolbar. Works offline. Optional paid Pro with a meeting planner, clock sets and more.
author: Larchwick

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run lint && npm test && npm run e2e
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/zips --filename clockpane-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/edge --artifacts-dir dist/zips --filename clockpane-edge-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
